info.title: Event manager public API
info.description: Read-only catalog for client websites and CMSes. Responses are cached at the edge for 30 s. Times are UTC; format them in the event's timezone.

publishableKey.name: key
publishableKey.description: Publishable key. Safe to use in browsers.

previewToken.description: Preview token (prv_…). Server-side only; also returns draft events; never cached.

channelKey.description: Sales channel key (sk_…). Server-side only; offers are limited to the channel's, with SKUs and limits, and ticketed occurrences show exact places left; never cached.

get.summary: Occurrences in start order, each with its event, effective location, tags and admission link

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Falls back to the account's default locale

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Default: now. Occurrences still running at this time are included.

url.description: Hosted registration page. Null for invite-only occurrences: guests register through their personal invitation links

anyOf.description: Tickets are sold through the account's own web shop and box office; offers lists what is for sale

admission.description: How to get in. More modes (registration, tickets) are added later without changing these.

status.description: Registration: waitlist: full, but registering joins the waitlist. closed: registration has not opened, has closed, or the occurrence is cancelled. Tickets: sold_out: no on-sale offer's smallest purchase fits in the places left (held places count as gone). not_on_sale: no offer is on sale now. New statuses may be added

opensAt.description: Null: open as soon as the event is published. Tickets: the earliest sales window opening of the offers

closesAt.description: Tickets: the latest sales window closing of the offers

placesLeft.description: Ticketed occurrences with a channel key only: places left; null without a limit

anyOf.description: Registration and ticketed occurrences: places without exact numbers; channel keys also get exact places left for ticketed occurrences (docs/ticketing.md). Null otherwise

onSale.description: False when the occurrence is cancelled or outside the sales window. Channel keys: also when the channel has no SKU for the offer

opensAt.description: Sales window here. Null: on sale as soon as the event is published

closesAt.description: End of the sales window, at the start at the latest

code.description: The user group's stable code, as the frontend knows it

access.description: User groups that may attend or buy (docs/user-groups.md); empty: everyone. The platform does not know who the visitor is: the frontend decides how to show a restricted event, and the reservations API enforces it

sku.description: Channel keys only: the channel's product for this offer; null: none mapped, so not on sale

items.description: A ticket type at this occurrence, in display order. Offers taken off sale here are left out

status.description: draft only with a preview token

locale.description: Locale of title and description (falls back to the account default)
